Theorem
[Closed eigenforms on $S^n$ (Theorem K.22)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0370 ↗ thm:chow-iv-k21-hodge-decomposition 1. appk:K.22\group Sphere Spectrum

The $k$-th eigenvalue on closed $p$-forms on the unit sphere is \[ \lambda _k^{[p]}(S^n)=(k+p)(n+k-p+1). \] The eigenspace consists of restrictions of degree-$k$ homogeneous harmonic $p$-forms on $\mathbb R^{n+1}$.
